verdict.rationale: Proa's components are typed Rust components rendered on the server, with vendored Shadcn-style UI and hydrated islands that emit vanilla-JS modules. Nothing in the pack shows authoring standards-based Web Components or Custom Elements (customElements.define, shadow DOM). Islands and Rust components are a different component model, so they get no credit for this story, which applies to a web framework but is unevidenced here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author standards-based web components and custom elements using the framework
